description: This file sets up and runs a speech translation pipeline using Pipecat framework, including configuration, transport, and processing components for a translation bot with Gladia service integration.

classes.name: TranscriptionLogger
classes.description: A FrameProcessor that logs transcription and translation frames to the console.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes a frame, printing transcription or translation text based on frame type, then pushes the frame forward.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Initializes and runs the speech translation pipeline with specified transport and runner arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the translation bot, setting up transport and starting the pipeline.
